thread:
maya: Hey folks — quick one: PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321|#4321> changes `runtime/k8s` manifests and `runtime/serving/packaging`. CODEOWNERS points `runtime/*` -> @sophia and `infra/k8s/*` -> @kai, but this PR touches both. Who can approve the whole thing so I can merge today?

liam: @sophia would be primary for runtime, but infra needs to sign off on k8s. We usually require both. If you want to unblock, one of us can proxy for the other with a comment.

sophia: I can review the runtime bits today. I'll need infra sign-off for the manifest changes.

jen: For future: consider splitting to runtime-only and infra-only. But for now, proxy approval is fine if infra ack in thread.

eng-bot: CODEOWNERS snippet for affected paths:
```
/runtime/* @sophia
/infra/k8s/* @kai
```

maya: Thanks. @liam — can you proxy infra approval once I add the PR label `infra-proxy`? That will let us merge after your +1.

liam: Yep I can do that. Quick checklist: confirm k8s manifest doesn't change PodSecurityPolicy or RBAC. If not, I'll +1.

maya: It doesn't touch PSP/RBAC, only resource requests/limits and nodeSelector. I'll add the label and request review.

sophia: I'm starting review now. If runtime LGTM I'll post inline.

liam: quick heads-up — I won't be able to +1 until 2pm PT. If you need earlier, ping @kai.

maya: ok will wait for liam; pinging here so it's visible. thanks all :thumbsup: \\n
sophia: runtime LGTM, left 2 nits.

liam: infra checked, nothing risky. +1 from me for infra side. merge after sqa checks pass.

maya: merging after CI passes. tagging release notes. Thanks :rocket:
